name: Multi-step arithmetic word problems
definition: Some problems need three or four ordinary steps in the right order. The skill is planning the route before calculating - writing down what you need next - so that you do not solve a step you do not need or stop one step early.
recognizeWhen: she buys several items and then shares them
work out how many are left at the end
the answer needs more than one calculation
after doing this, how many remain
misconceptions: I did the calculations in the order the numbers appeared in the question.
I solved an intermediate step and gave that as my final answer.
I lost track of which number meant what halfway through.
